engine.notes: ComedySportz started here in 1984 and still anchors the scene from its own arena in Walker's Point. The longform home passed from Ampersand Theater to the community-owned Interchange Theater Co-op in the same Westown church basement. Milwaukee Improv in Brookfield and The Laughing Tap are stand-up rooms.

entries.name: ComedySportz Milwaukee
entries.summary: The original ComedySportz, founded here in 1984: two teams play clean short-form improv matches in a 420 S 1st Street arena with its own bar and restaurant, plus four levels of adult workshops.
entries.schedule: Matches Fri & Sat 7:30pm and 10pm; The Midnite Show Sat 11:59pm (18+)
signals: Four class levels 101-104, eight weeks each
Student showcases on the main stage
Full bar and restaurant in the venue
entries.reasons: Four decades in its own venue, a complete beginner-to-showcase class ladder and four weekly matches; only the missing class start dates hold it back.

entries.name: Interchange Theater Co-op
entries.summary: Milwaukee's community-owned longform improv theater in the lower level of Calvary Presbyterian Church, with five class levels, weekend shows and a Sunday open jam and open mic.
entries.schedule: Shows Thu-Sat 7:30pm; Open Jam / Open Mic Sundays 6pm
signals: Cooperative: one $200 share per owner, board elected by shareholders
Level 1 sections full, Level 3 sold out (fall 2026)
Took over the former Ampersand Theater space at 628 N 10th St
entries.reasons: A young co-op, but it has a permanent home, a full longform curriculum that is selling out and weekly shows plus a jam; standing is still local.

entries.name: Comedy College
entries.summary: A stand-up school running since 1999 out of Rounding Third sports bar, with a free weekly improv class on Mondays and The Event showcase every Thursday.
entries.schedule: Free improv class Mondays; The Event Thursdays 8:15pm; Standup 101 term started Sep 10, 2026
signals: Standup 101 is a 7-week course with a graduation show
Alumni credits on Fallon and Conan
entries.reasons: Long-running and current, but stand-up is the core; improv is a free drop-in rather than a levelled programme and the home is a sports bar.
